expectedComments: Explain the AS-facing contract, selected inputs, exact observations, and the important ownership/boundary rule for: Adds Value when no equal element is already present. Adds every element from Array. Adds every element from another set. Removes an equal element and reports whether one existed. Removes every element and reserves optional capacity. @param Slack Desired post-clear allocation capacity. Removes every element while retaining reusable allocation.
expectedObservations: Consume every non-void result and compare its exact semantic value. Observe receiver, object, collection, callback, diagnostic, or lifecycle state after each void call. Exercise both true and false outcomes unless the API contract documents a single reachable result.
inputs: Seeded receiver state, the exact mutation arguments, repeated-call behavior, and cleanup or restoration inputs where the operation owns resources.
testScope: void TSet<T>.Add(const T& Value); | void TSet<T>.Append(const TArray<T>& Array); | void TSet<T>.Append(const TSet<T>& Set); | bool TSet<T>.Remove(const T& Value); | void TSet<T>.Empty(int32 Slack = 0); | void TSet<T>.Reset();
